motivation: Change the fabric that runs Chuggy by hand: its NixOS hosts and modules, its cluster declarations, and the scripts that generate the rest.
acceptanceCriteria: The ticket-specific acceptance criteria are satisfied, and the release manifests still identify one source.
constraints: Read AGENTS.md and .chug/tasks/review-change.md before changing the repository.

A build request is rendered with scripts/render-build-request from the previous request's arguments for the same image; never hand-written. The source commit is chuggy main at run time unless the brief names another.
Generate a release -- image digests, source-commit annotations and the migrate Job name under cluster/apps -- with scripts/render-release; never edit one in place.
main is live: Flux applies cluster/ and builds/, so a merged request starts a build and a merged manifest deploys; results/ it does not apply. Open a pull request; do not merge it.
Do not rebuild or switch a host, reconcile Flux, apply manifests, restart infrastructure, reset data, or deploy.

instructions: Implement the requested change and extend the fabric's own checks to cover what it adds.
Run .chug/tasks/ci.sh, and report which nix flake check entries the change still needs run: that command does not run them.
Read .chug/tasks/review-change.md and review the change exactly as that brief requires.
